criterion: 每項新增條款標明強度與適用條件；必要要求不被降為建議，可選方法不豁免 MUST；不採 SHOULD 有理由；程式規則與階段流程各在其文件，既有強度及例外政策未變。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Each rule retains its ID, strength, condition and requirement; SHOULD deviation is explained. Required finding for the counterexample: Treating an optional method as permission to waive a MUST, or adding agent steps to rule rows, fails review.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
